conclusion: The primitive type-6 character has an exact 32,000-element certified symmetry, reducing original chamber roots to 149,760. Canonical type-only infinitesimal tie breakers are globally obstructed.  The first-sheet Fourier potential escapes that proof but is frame-dependent, so neither the old identity pass nor a 124-template scan is a global Track-B result.

exactOrbitCompleteScanner.completenessBoundary: 149,760 is exact only for original chamber vertices; a complete Track-B result requires the cell action/catalogue and every new link
exactOrbitCompleteScanner.step1: construct Q=<s0,...,s4> on the 650 Section-5 vertices and the exact 74,880-point right-coset action on L\Q
exactOrbitCompleteScanner.step2: lift each frame to the two t0 signs; s0,...,s4 use the Schreier rows, s5 toggles t0 by the first bit of its merged color, and s6 toggles t0
exactOrbitCompleteScanner.step3: use the reduced chamber action together with the 31 L\Q/W_U component catalogues and stabilizer multiplicities to enumerate cell orbits and compute the exact rational U(C)
exactOrbitCompleteScanner.step4: for one representative of every reduced cell orbit, expand the actual lower W_T/W_R face cosets and unique spherical cofaces; quotient-type connectivity alone is insufficient
exactOrbitCompleteScanner.step5: test nonempty connected ascending and descending comparability graphs at every cell barycenter, including all subdivision vertices

fixedCharacterSymmetry.declaredProductAction: (a,l).(t,q)=(t+a,lq), with a in F2^9 and l in Chen's color subgroup L
fixedCharacterSymmetry.freenessReason: a fixed chamber forces a=0 in the sheet coordinate and l=1 in the left-regular Q coordinate
fixedCharacterSymmetry.fullSheetTranslationOutsideStabilizer: a translation with a0=1 negates both c6 and the first-sheet Fourier character
fixedCharacterSymmetry.sheetTranslationCriterion: a fixes c6 exactly iff a0=0

fourierFrameDependence.consequence: the Fourier potential cannot be scanned by the 124 type-only templates; the colored L\Q frame is part of a complete key

nonClaims: Track B has not passed globally for P2.

primitiveCharacter.formula: c6(t,q)=(-1)^t0 on generator 6 and zero on generators 0,...,5

+dimension.witness: at a t0=0 chamber barycenter, all coface barycenters are higher, so the descending link is empty

-dimension.witness: at any maximal type-5 cell barycenter, every proper face is higher and there is no coface, so the descending link is empty

hypotheses.genericOnRawTies: p(S) != p(T) whenever comparable types S,T have equal raw average
hypotheses.rawDominance: on every incidence where the doubled raw averages differ by one, the sign of that raw difference is preserved
hypotheses.typeOnly: p(C)=p(T) for every cell C of spherical type T

rawDominantTypeOnlyNoGo.nonClaim: This is not an obstruction to arbitrary-amplitude type potentials: such a potential may reverse a nonzero raw comparison.
proof: Choose a p-minimal spherical type T among the 62 types not containing generator 6.
Use a type-T cell represented by a chamber with t0=0.
Every proper lower face and every coface avoiding generator 6 has equal raw average and strictly larger p by minimality and genericity.
If T contains generator 5, it has no generator-6 coface because {5,6} is nonspherical.
Otherwise every generator-6 coface has larger doubled raw average by one, and raw dominance keeps it larger after p is added.
Hence every comparable barycentric vertex is higher and the descending link is empty.
rawDominantTypeOnlyNoGo.scope: generic cell-type-only p(T) in the raw-dominant infinitesimal tie-breaking regime

typeTemplateAudit.templateDerivation: types avoiding both bases occur with the two type-6 edge signs; a type-5 cell has no type-6 coface; a type-6 cell contains both raw-height layers and needs no separate sign template
